## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/check_public_safety.py`
- [ ] Python source compiles successfully
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass

## Public-Safety Review

- [ ] No operational URL, hostname, page hint, selector, or navigation script
- [ ] No username, credential, token, cookie, profile, or session data
- [ ] No personal/company path, SQL, schema, internal identifier, or schedule
- [ ] No downloaded report, data file, screenshot, HTML/HAR dump, or log
- [ ] Example configuration remains synthetic and non-operational
- [ ] No ignored file was force-added

## Compatibility

Note any CLI, configuration, output, or dependency changes.
